phase.label: Market Research & Validation
phase.summary:
## MARKET VALIDATION

### Pain Score (1-10): 9
Why it hurts: Merchants lose 15-30% of ad spend on "ghost clicks"—traffic for out-of-stock items or products where CAC exceeds net margin. Standard tracking ignores COGS and shipping fluctuations, leading to "profitable" ROAS that results in actual bank

keyData.concept: ProfitBridge AI: Integração Shopify/Google Ads para automação de lances baseada em lucro real e estoque. Mecanismo Único: Monitoramento de Webhooks de estoque + Calculadora de Margem Dinâmica que aciona Kill-Switch em anúncios de SKUs com baixo estoque ou margem negativa. Roadmap de 8 Ciclos focado em MVP funcional e escalonamento técnico.

gate.reason: The market validation shows a high-intensity pain point with a clear technical mechanism (Kill-Switch) to solve it. All advisors agree the fundamentals and leverage points are strong.
